name: HyperFrames Studio
summary: HeyGen's open-source HTML video editor (timeline, code and live preview), hosted inside Neyvia; the side panel reads the timeline, renders a draft and runs the outcome contracts through neyvia.video.*. Apache-2.0.

upstream.package: @hyperframes/studio via the hyperframes CLI preview server

permissions: Starts the HyperFrames Studio preview server on 127.0.0.1:49165 for a project folder you choose (no browser window opens)
Reads and writes that project folder
No network access beyond loopback; telemetry off
credit: HyperFrames and @hyperframes/studio by HeyGen (Apache-2.0), unmodified. App page by the Neyvia video tracks (track/laya-video app.js, track/video store entry), reconciled on 7 Oct.

actions.name: open
actions.description: Serve Studio for a video project on 127.0.0.1:49165-49167 and show it here.

actions.name: timeline
actions.description: Read the project's timeline as a CL Scene and its pre-render findings (neyvia.video.timeline).

actions.name: render
actions.description: Render a draft MP4 headless and run the outcome contracts on it.
